    detail_response = session.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/deliveries/{quote(str(delivery_id), safe='')}",
        timeout=30,

        delivery_details.append({**delivery, "_detailUnavailable": True})

    detail_response.raise_for_status()
    delivery_details.append(detail_response.json())

    status = str(delivery.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
    materials = delivery.get("materials") or []
    explicitly_unnecessary = delivery.get("necessary") is False
    explicitly_incomplete = status in {
        "incomplete",
        "cancelled",
        "canceled",
        "failed",

    } or delivery.get("complete") is False

import requests

# Retrieve the status of all monitored infrastructure components.
status_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/infrastructure/status")
status_response.raise_for_status()
status_data = status_response.json()
components = status_data.get("components", [])

# Identify components that may need attention based on their reported status.
issue_statuses = {"under maintenance", "faulty"}
potential_issues = [
    component
    for component in components
    if str(component.get("status", "")).strip().lower() in issue_statuses
]

# Retrieve consumption patterns to inform energy-saving recommendations.
patterns_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/analytics/consumption-pattern")
patterns_response.raise_for_status()
consumption_patterns = patterns_response.json()

# Retrieve failure predictions as an additional indicator of potential issues.
predictions_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/infrastructure/failure-predictions"
)
predictions_response.raise_for_status()
predictions = predictions_response.json().get("predictions", [])

# Run anomaly detection for all components with irregular or concerning status.
component_ids = [
    component["id"]
    for component in components
    if component.get("id")
    and (
        str(component.get("status", "")).strip().lower() in issue_statuses
        or any(
            prediction.get("componentId") == component["id"]
            and prediction.get("failureProbability", 0) > 0
            for prediction in predictions
        )
    )
]

# If no issues are apparent from status or predictions, analyze all components.
if not component_ids:
    component_ids = [component["id"] for component in components if component.get("id")]

anomaly_result = None
if component_ids:
    anomaly_response = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/alerts/anomaly-detection",
        json={
            "componentIds": component_ids,
            "timePeriod": {
                "start": "2026-11-02T00:00:00Z",
                "end": "2026-11-03T00:00:00Z",
            },
        },
    )
    anomaly_response.raise_for_status()
    anomaly_result = anomaly_response.json()

# Adjust notification preferences for integration-friendly alert delivery.
# The documented settings endpoint supports email/SMS alerts and thresholds.
settings_response = requests.patch(
    f"{BASE_URL}/settings/notification-preferences",
    json={
        "emailAlerts": True,
        "smsAlerts": True,
        "thresholds": {
            "anomalyDetection": 0.8,
            "failureProbability": 0.8,
        },
    },
)
settings_response.raise_for_status()

# Keep the analysis and recommendations available to the caller.
analysis = {
    "components": components,
    "potentialIssues": potential_issues,
    "failurePredictions": predictions,
    "consumptionPatterns": consumption_patterns,
    "energySavingRecommendations": [
        "Shift flexible electricity use away from peak hours where possible.",
        "Prioritize consumption patterns reported as high impact when planning reductions.",
        "Review component anomalies and failure predictions before changing operating schedules.",
    ],
    "anomalyDetection": anomaly_result,
    "notificationPreferencesUpdated": settings_response.status_code == 200,
}
